description: This Java source file defines a test class 'WidgetMacroLibraryTests' that performs a suite of HTTP-based tests on various macro libraries (HTML, Text, XML, CSV, XLS, FOP) within the OFBiz framework to ensure correct responses and absence of macro errors.

classes.name: WidgetMacroLibraryTests
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the proper functioning of macro library pages in the OFBiz framework by performing HTTP requests and parsing responses for macro errors.

methods.name: initHttpClient
methods.description: Initializes and configures an HttpClient instance with redirect-following, untrusted certificates, and host verification settings.

methods.name: testHtmlMacroLibrary
methods.description: Tests the HTML macro library page by making an HTTP POST request and verifying response status, content type, and absence of macro errors.

methods.name: testTextMacroLibrary
methods.description: Tests the Text macro library page similarly to the HTML test, focusing on text response content type and macro error absence.

methods.name: testXmlMacroLibrary
methods.description: Performs an XML macro library verification, ensuring correct content type and no macro error indicators.

methods.name: testCsvMacroLibrary
methods.description: Verifies the CSV macro library page for correct response and no macro errors.

methods.name: testXlsMacroLibrary
methods.description: Checks the XLS macro library page for proper response content type and macro error absence.

methods.name: testFopMacroLibrary
methods.description: Tests the FOP macro library for generating a valid PDF response and checks for macro error traces within the PDF content.
